lead: Up to twelve pictures on one side, rich text and one call to action on the other, with a toggle that swaps the sides.
bodytext:
The collage reflows on the number of pictures rather than on a variant switch: one photograph fills the column, two sit side by side, and an odd last picture spans the row instead of leaving a hole beside it. Nothing has to be re-chosen when a picture is added or removed.

Every frame carries its own ratio, so uploads of mixed proportions still tile evenly — and the frame that spans the row takes a wider one, or it would be twice as tall as its neighbours and swamp the copy.
